name: Mellow Fly HV-TMC5160 Pro
description: The Mellow Fly HV-TMC5160 Pro is a high-performance external stepper motor driver module that supports the SPI communication protocol, making it suitable for applications requiring precise motion control and high energy efficiency. Two hardware revisions ship — V1.2 and V1.5 — but both use the same 0.033 Ω sense resistor, so `run_current` values are consistent across revisions. Specs on this entry are cited from Mellow's V1.5 documentation; the V1.2 page on mellow.klipper.cn confirms matching electrical characteristics.
